title: 安全電子郵件閘道
summary: 以郵件身份、網域對齊與隔離判讀串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect mail identity, domain alignment and quarantine analysis through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: Envelope 與 From：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Envelope and From: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「Envelope 與 From」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For envelope and from, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「Envelope 與 From」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：傳輸寄件身分與可見 From 可能不同。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定郵件內容，只改 envelope 與 From 網域。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「SPF 邊界」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around envelope and from, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Transport sender identity can differ from visible From. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix content and vary envelope/From domains. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat spf boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定郵件內容，只改 envelope 與 From 網域。 比較「Envelope 與 From」與「SPF 邊界」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix content and vary envelope/From domains. Compare whether evidence for envelope and from and spf boundaries supports the same inference.
steps.failure: SPF 通過表示郵件所有內容必定安全。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: SPF pass proves all message content safe. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「Envelope 與 From」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 傳輸寄件身分與可見 From 可能不同。

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想每日 10000 封、100 封惡意；規則偵測 90 封且誤標正常信 99 封，precision=90/(90+99)=47.62%，recall=90%。高 recall 仍可能有大量誤攔。
knowledge.textEn: Of 10000 hypothetical messages, 100 malicious, detecting 90 with 99 benign false alarms gives precision=47.62% and recall=90%; high recall can coexist with many false blocks.
